// 02 — projects
What I've Built
☁ Serverless Event-Driven Processing Engine
Personal Cloud Project · AWS Always Free Tier · Sep 2026

Engineered a fully serverless, zero-cost event-driven processing pipeline on AWS Always Free Tier. Decoupled data ingestion from backend processing using SQS for frontend responsiveness under heavy loads. Implemented dual Lambda functions — an Ingestion Lambda (via Function URL) returning immediate 202 Accepted response and a background Worker Lambda polling SQS — simulating enterprise-grade async workflows. Secured with Amazon Cognito (JWT auth), tracked job lifecycle in DynamoDB (PENDING → COMPLETED), and triggered automated SNS email alerts on task completion. Frontend deployed via AWS Amplify CI/CD.

AWS LambdaSQSDynamoDB SNSCognitoAWS Amplify React.jsPythonServerlessCI/CD
AI-Based Interview Monitoring & Evaluation System
UptoSkills · Feb 2026 – May 2026

An intelligent proctoring platform for online interviews, assessments, and examinations. Features webcam-based analysis, real-time gaze tracking, object detection, and live risk scoring. Implements multi-speaker detection using offline K-Means clustering with Librosa and OpenAI Whisper for speech analysis. Built three modular sub-systems: Failure Handling & Recovery Engine (designed for AWS Lambda deployment), AI Interview Intelligence Engine with adaptive difficulty, and a Real-Time Interview Integrity Monitor.
